title: PhD student position in Bioinformatics/Evolutionary Microbiology
location_detail: Department of Medical Biochemistry and Microbiology, Biomedical Centre
description: Reconstruct the evolutionary history, metabolic potential and host-adaptation genes of deep-branching intracellular Gammaproteobacteria using genomes, metagenomics and evolutionary analysis.
match_reasons: Master's-level biotechnology/nanotechnology training and molecular-biology research align with the stated degree backgrounds
Documented Python/R, Linux and reproducible scientific-data workflows support the required coding component
Research publications, independent project work and experimental molecular-biology experience support the doctoral research setting
gaps: Metagenomics and molecular-evolution method development are not documented as established specialisms
The application should describe microbial-evolution motivation honestly rather than imply prior Legionella research
headline: Bioinformatics & Molecular Biology Researcher | Genomics, Reproducible Analysis and Experimental Science
statement: Interdisciplinary researcher with a background in molecular biology, biotechnology and current bioinformatics training. I combine experimental research and scientific publication experience with Python/R-based analysis, Linux and reproducible workflows. I am motivated to develop deeper expertise in comparative genomics, metagenomics and molecular evolution, while contributing careful data analysis and practical understanding of biological experiments to a collaborative microbiology research environment.

title: PhD-student in Evolutionary and Ecological Genetics
location_detail: Department of Ecology and Genetics, Evolutionary Biology Center
description: Experimental and computational evolutionary-genetics research using RNA-seq, DNA pool-seq, comparative genomics and phenotypic data from an evolve-and-resequence seed-beetle system.
match_reasons: Documented bioinformatics study, R/Python analysis and reproducible workflows are relevant to the project's genomics and scripting focus
Molecular-biology, sequencing-data and experimental research experience provides a useful bridge between wet-lab and computational work
Research publications, independent project work and collaboration at KI, KTH and SciLifeLab support doctoral research readiness
The advert explicitly welcomes applicants from bioinformatics or related fields and values server/cluster pipeline experience
gaps: Ecology, evolutionary biology and population-genetics concepts are not explicitly documented in the master CV
No documented experimental-evolution, insect-model or genetic-strain work
Experience applying statistical methods to quantitative-genetic or population-genomic data should be demonstrated only where substantiated
headline: Bioinformatics & Molecular Biology Researcher | Genomics, Reproducible Analysis & Experimental Research
statement: Interdisciplinary researcher with a biology research and publication background, now building bioinformatics skills alongside molecular and cellular laboratory experience. I use R, Python, Linux and reproducible workflows to work with sequencing and transcriptomic data, and I am comfortable connecting experimental questions with computational analysis. I would bring this bridge between wet-lab and computational colleagues to evolutionary-genetics research while developing deeper expertise in ecology, population genomics and quantitative genetics.

title: PhD student in Bioinformatics — AI-driven Multiscale Modelling of Membrane Protein Complexes
location_detail: Department of Biochemistry and Biophysics, SciLifeLab
description: Develop deep-learning-based multiscale models of membrane protein complexes, integrating proteomics, glycoproteomics, structural mass spectrometry and lipidomics with experimental collaborators.
match_reasons: Bioinformatics training, Python/R work and reproducible scientific workflows provide a credible computational foundation
Molecular-biology, cancer-biology and omics experience offer relevant biological context for proteomic and membrane-biology collaboration
Published research and cross-disciplinary work at KI, KTH and SciLifeLab support doctoral-level scientific communication
gaps: Deep-learning, AlphaFold-based structural modelling and membrane-protein modelling are not documented as established experience
The application should frame these as skills to develop, not claim advanced machine-learning expertise
headline: Bioinformatics & Molecular Biology Researcher | Omics, Reproducible Analysis and Interdisciplinary Science
statement: Interdisciplinary researcher bridging molecular biology and bioinformatics, with experience in scientific programming, reproducible analysis and experimental life science. My research and current bioinformatics training have developed my ability to work with biological data in Python and R and to communicate across experimental and computational teams. I am motivated to build specialised expertise in structural bioinformatics and machine learning while contributing a careful biological perspective to collaborative multi-omics research.
